name: Jorou Gumo ~Jubaku no Mesu Dorei-tachi~
original_name: 女郎蜘蛛 ～呪縛の牝奴隷達～
source:
A guy got a part time job with a very strange family. During the daytime, he can explore the house or sort documents. During the evenings, he gets to play rope tricks with the mother and two daughters. If he can survive and find out what's going on, he might end up happy with one of the girls.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个人在一个非常奇怪的家庭找到了一份兼职工作。白天，他可以探索房子或整理文件。晚上，他会和母亲和两个女儿一起玩绳子戏法。如果他能活下来并查明发生了什么事，他最终可能会和其中一个女孩幸福地在一起。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
